//ignoreCommand: Most commits to this repository are game work, not site work: a Godot
export changes 18MB of pack and never touches web/. Without this, every one
of them would spend a Vercel build, and Hobby allows 100 deployments a day.
Run from the Root Directory, so ./ is web/ and everything the site is built
from -- pages, components, generated balance and sprite JSON, and the
candidate sheets in public/ -- is inside it.
Exit 0 means ignore the build, exit 1 means continue; git diff --quiet exits
0 when nothing changed, which is exactly the case worth skipping.
//redirects: The games are not deployed here -- 150MB exceeds the 100MB static upload
limit on Hobby -- so a guessed URL is sent to the host that does have them.
Temporary, not permanent: if the games ever move, a 308 cached in browsers
